description: This Java class Path2IAR generates an XML-like group and file structure for a specified directory tree, specifically targeting a firmware directory within a project. It processes folders and files, filtering for C and C++ source/header files, and outputs structured information along with relative paths and includes.

classes.name: Path2IAR
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating project group structure and includes for the firmware source files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that kicks off the directory processing and writes the output.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Recursively processes a directory, building an XML structure with file and folder information, filtering for C/C++ source/header files, and updating include paths.
